ValidationRule.description: SWIFT/BIC Code should be 8-11 characters alpha numeric
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Payment (EFT)') || ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Ticket Refund EFT'), NOT(ISBLANK(Branch_Swift_BIC_Code__c)), NOT(REGEX(Branch_Swift_BIC_Code__c, "^[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,11}$")), ISCHANGED(Branch_Swift_BIC_Code__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SWIFT/BIC Code should be 8-11 characters alpha numeric
